nodes.label: LangGraph Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: One shared graph (parse -> context_build -> 5 parallel analysts -> debate -> judge -> decide) serves the live API, schedulers, and retrigger paths; only the run_id prefix differs, keeping behavior identical across entry points.

nodes.label: RuleEvaluator (rules.json)
nodes.rationale: Scoring, signals, and override rules are deliberately LLM-free and deterministic; the LLM only adds narrative, so signal outcomes are auditable and reproducible. Rules with missing context inputs are marked skipped rather than failing the run.

nodes.label: ContextBuilder
nodes.rationale: Aggregates OHLC, fundamentals, and news/sentiment from providers (Upstox, Yahoo, screener.in, GDELT) into one structured dict; provider failures or rate limits leave fields absent, which downstream surfaces as 'rules skipped' rather than an LLM failure.

nodes.label: DecisionAgent (Deterministic Decision Layer)
nodes.rationale: Position sizing bands, stop/target, requires_human_review, and low-data-coverage caps use no LLM at all, so any logic that 'moves money' stays auditable.

nodes.label: Multi-Provider LLM Resolution (instructor + LiteLLM)
nodes.rationale: instructor over litellm lets any one of OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Mistral/Groq keys power all chat steps via LLM_PROVIDER_PRIORITY; with no key configured, narrators fall back to templates so the deterministic pipeline still runs without external LLM calls.

nodes.label: Hybrid RAG (Qdrant + BM25)
nodes.rationale: Optional retrieval layer that enriches judge context only when Qdrant is configured; the system degrades gracefully without it.

nodes.label: Daily Run Idempotency Key
nodes.rationale: Ticker + market + UTC calendar day maps to a fixed 16-char hex run_id; a duplicate POST returns the existing run (idempotent_hit=True) instead of starting a second graph, preventing wasted tokens and conflicting runs.

nodes.label: Event Bus (Redis or In-Memory)
nodes.rationale: RunManager streams lifecycle events over Redis when configured, else in-memory, so SSE progress works in both local and production setups.

nodes.label: Schedulers (Intraday / Daily / RetriggerSubscriber)
nodes.rationale: IntradayScheduler fires every 5 minutes during NSE hours, DailyScheduler once per business day at 10:00 IST, and RetriggerSubscriber reacts to Redis retrigger:* events (e.g. Upstox WS thresholds) with cooldowns; all reuse the same orchestrator graph with distinct run_id prefixes.

nodes.label: Deploy Split: API on Render, UI on Vercel
nodes.rationale: The FastAPI agent needs long-running POSTs, long SSE streams, background schedulers, and Redis-backed checkpoints, which Vercel serverless cannot host (timeouts, cold starts, no long-lived process); so the API runs on a container/VM host via the Render Blueprint while only the Next.js UI goes to Vercel.

nodes.label: Deterministic-Score / LLM-Narrative Separation
nodes.rationale: Core design principle of the system: every score, signal, override, and money-moving decision is computed deterministically by the rule engine and decision layer, while LLMs are confined to narrative, debate framing, and synthesis. This keeps outcomes auditable, reproducible, testable offline without API keys, and robust when no LLM key is configured (templated fallbacks).
